configuration: Legacy Rigaku D/Max-B, University of Nebraska–Lincoln Co Kα Bragg–Brentano variant, flat vertically mounted specimen, graphite diffracted-beam monochromator and point detector. No material handling, live source power or radiation exposure is simulated.
history: Nominal 1985 D/Max-B series; later campus configurations differ. WashU's reference record is a Cu variant and is not the selected configuration.

measurements.radiusBasis: UNL detailed D/Max-B instrument specifications; instrument parameters, p. 1.
measurements.spectrumBasis: UNL Co Kα weighted wavelength. A single effective line cancels doublet coupling in the educational model.
estimatedGeometry: scan arm body, motor footprints and detector body
measurements.thirdPartyAssets: None reproduced. Manufacturer period advert and university photography linked for inspection.
